Job Description Summary

Prior to submitting your application, please visit our early careers website to find out more about the schemes we offer and the recruitment journey: www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com.

Job Description

Engineer the safety net that protects millions

The Chief Security Office helps us move fast without compromising security, resilience or control.

It protects our people, customers, data and technology while building security into the products, platforms and journeys people use every day. 

And as a Cyber Security Engineer graduate, your work will be nothing short of impactful. You’ll work in the enabling layer of CSO, doing the hard yards of reducing cyber risk at every level. That includes designing and building controls, tooling, detection logic and securing systems that protect millions.

Two years. Real impact

Throughout this two-year scheme, you’ll go beyond just putting out fires. Your work will be centred on secure design, detection capability and risk reduction – as you build security into the bones of every system, platform and delivery process.

​Expect to:

Build and improve security tools and services that help us innovate and safely go faster
Create solutions that protect customers, colleagues and data from cyber threats
Automate repetitive tasks and security checks to make processes faster, simpler and more reliable
Help keep critical systems secure, resilient and available when they are needed most
Work across software engineering, cloud, infrastructure and DevOps to design and deliver secure technology solutions
What your work could look like

Helping engineering teams embed security into every design and deliverable
Taking our detection capability, response logic, rules, and controls to the next level
Building secure infrastructure using code, laying strong and scalable foundations
Improving the way we build, test and release pipelines (CI/CD)
Automating the stuff that doesn’t need to be manual – reducing risk and room for error
Contributing to a security-minded engineering culture
Skills you’d own

By the end of the scheme, you’ll:

Get comfortable in the cloud learn how modern cloud technology powers secure digital services working with platforms such as Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure
Build things that are safe from the start, using tools like Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform and CI/CD pipelines
Use code to solve real problems, developing practical skills in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Node.js
Explore how security works behind the scenes, from protecting sensitive information to identifying and responding to cyber threats
Automate the repetitive stuff – to make security faster, simpler and more reliable with less risk and fewer mistakes
Build skills that can keep up – because the tools, projects and cyber threats may change, but adaptable strong engineering thinking will always matter
Teams you’d touch base with

This is a role with real variety and impact. You’ll work with teams across different security labs and teams, gaining experience in everything from cloud security and cyber defence to AI, digital identity and threat protection. Along the way, you’ll see how different technologies, teams and security capabilities come together to help protect millions of customers, how they work together to protect the business and enable us to safely go faster. 

What you’ll take away

Being an expert in design discussions and risk-based decision making
Going beyond prevention into detection thinking
Taking automation, scripting and configuration-driven engineering head-on
Mastering tools like Python, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and data platforms
Support in your corner

You’ll get:

Opportunities to acquire certifications in Google Cloud Platform and Associate Cloud Engineer.
Access to the CSO Security Engineering Guild, where engineers connect, learn, share knowledge and build their skills together.
Hands-on Tech Days where you’ll participate in Catch the Flag (CTF) challenges, hackathons, and real-world problem solving.
Anchor Days across hub locations that bring colleagues together for hands on learning, collaboration and community building.
Specifically curated Security Learning Pathways to support your skill build and bringing security skills to life.
Requirements 

What you need to apply 

While we do not require a set minimum degree achievement, we strongly recommend the ability to demonstrate sound knowledge, understanding and technical skills aligned to the role. Some aspects of this will be assessed through the application process.
Note: We cannot sponsor visas. 
A strong foundation in Python coding, as it is the main language used across Security Engineering.
Locations  

This programme operates in various UK regional locations, including Leeds, Edinburgh and Manchester. 

You’ll select one of these regional locations and will be based in various offices for the duration of your programme. We support hybrid working, where you’ll be expected to spend a minimum of two days each week in the office where you have been placed. 

Opening and Closing Date  

Apply soon, as our schemes may close early if we receive a high number of applications.

  

How to Apply 

Our application process is designed to help you shine. We want everyone to feel they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity, or culture.  

Find details, including stages and tips for success, on our How to Apply page.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We keep your data safe. So, we'll only ever ask you to provide confidential or sensitive information once you have formally been invited along to an interview or accepted a verbal offer to join us which is when we run our background checks.  We'll always explain what we need and why, with any request coming from a trusted Lloyds Banking Group person. 

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

Job Description


Junior IT Support Technician / Service Desk Analyst – Full Training Provided

Build your IT support career in a collaborative managed services team, providing first-line incident, request and access support for clients. This entry-level opportunity suits IT graduates and candidates with strong communication, problem-solving and computer literacy skills, with a provisional November 2026 start.

If you’ve also worked in the following roles, we’d also like to hear from you: Helpdesk Analyst, Technical Support Analyst, IT Technician, First Line Support Analyst, IT Helpdesk Analyst, Support Desk Analyst, Helpdesk Technician, IT Support Analyst, Technical Support Technician

A strong benefits package includes 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, a company pension, health cash plan, income protection and training and development.

SALARY: Up to £28,000 per annum (depending on experience) + Benefits

LOCATION: Hybrid - Bristol, South West England

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Fixed-Term Contract until 31 December 2027 (with the potential to go permanent)

WORKING HOURS: Monday–Friday 9:00am–5:30pm for the first 2 weeks, then a shift rota, typically 4 days on / 4 days off with 12-hour shifts; alternating one month on days (9:30am–9:30pm) and one month on nights (9:30pm–9:30am)

JOB OVERVIEW

This is an excellent opportunity to build practical IT support expertise in a collaborative managed services environment. The Junior IT Support Technician / Service Desk Analyst will build skills through structured ticket management and client support.

Reporting to the Service Operations Manager, the Junior IT Support Technician / Service Desk Analyst will manage incidents and service requests from first contact through resolution, escalation or handover in line with SLAs and KPIs.

The Junior IT Support Technician / Service Desk Analyst will also support monitoring, knowledge documentation, service continuity, security compliance and process improvement, including automation opportunities.

DUTIES

Your duties as the Junior IT Support Technician / Service Desk Analyst include:

Incident and Request Management: Log, manage and progress incidents and approved service requests accurately in line with procedures, SLAs and KPIs
Client Support and Communication: Provide telephone or chat support, keep clients informed and communicate complex incidents clearly to internal and external stakeholders
Monitoring and Escalation: Monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identify recurring incidents and opportunities for incident reduction, and escalate where necessary
Shift Handover and Service Continuity: Follow handover procedures, highlighting key tickets and critical upcoming tasks to maintain continuity
Knowledge and Documentation: Update and create knowledge articles and documentation, applying appropriate intellectual property and open-source licensing awareness
Process Improvement and Automation: Identify opportunities to optimise work and automate request fulfilment, incident resolution and wider processes
Security and Data Privacy: Follow information security and data privacy policies and the information security framework
ESG Contribution: Support environmental, social and governance objectives and contribute to a personal ESG goal through the performance management process
CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Entry-level IT support exposure or completion of a relevant internship programme
Computer literacy, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Teams
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining complex incidents clearly
Critical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively in a busy environment and adapt to changing circumstances
Active listening skills and a client-focused approach
Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups
Ability to plan ahead and support a knowledge-sharing culture
Sound understanding of intellectual property and open-source licensing in the context of software development
Good understanding of information security and data privacy requirements
Right to work in the UK is required; visa sponsorship is not available
 

BENEFITS

25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
Company pension
Income Protection
Health Cash Plan
Death in Service (4 x salary)
Training & Development
Employee discounts
Volunteer Day

Job Description:

2027 Technology Graduate Programme - London

TD Securities is offering an opportunity to join our 12-month Technology Graduate Programme in London, with a clear focus on engineering, data and artificial intelligence.

 

TD Securities provides a wide range of capital market products and services to corporate, government and institutional clients. The firm works with clients around the world, focusing selectively and strategically on the key financial centres: New York, Houston, Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, Montreal, Dublin, Tokyo, Singapore and London.

 

From your first day on the TDS Technology Graduate Program, you will contribute to meaningful technical work as part of a global team. The program combines structured learning with hands-on delivery, giving you experience across engineering, data and AI while working with colleagues in London and across TD Securities globally.

 

Application Requirements & Terms of Offer 

Position Overview  

Contract Type: Full-time, 12-Month Graduate Programme
Dates: July 2027
Location:
London Office: 60 Threadneedle Street
Candidates must have an unrestricted right to work in the UK throughout the entire duration of the program.
 

All applicants are required to submit their CV and a Cover Letter. Only complete applications will be accepted.  

 

How you will contribute:

We are looking for technically curious graduates who enjoy solving real problems, learning quickly and working collaboratively. During the programme, you will complete three rotations, giving you experience across different product and functional technology groups such as Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, Data & AI and Compliance. You will work with engineers, data specialists, product partners and business teams across regions, gaining a broad understanding of how technology supports TD Securities while delivering practical solutions with global impact.

Contribute to targeted team deliverables, developing new functionality and improving the applications, platforms and data capabilities that support TD Securities businesses globally.
Design, build, test and improve high-quality software, participating in debugging, peer reviews and the engineering practices needed to deliver reliable and secure solutions.
Work across the delivery lifecycle, from understanding a problem and shaping a solution through development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Gain practical experience across software engineering, data platforms, analytics, automation and applied AI. Your work may include building user experiences and services, integrating systems and APIs, improving data quality and accessibility, or exploring responsible uses of machine learning and generative AI to improve colleague and client outcomes.
 

Who we are looking for: 

Recent graduate (2026) or upcoming 2027 graduate with a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
A strong interest in engineering, data and AI, with the curiosity to explore emerging technologies and apply them to real problems.
A grounding in programming and software development concepts, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, placements, hackathons or other practical experience.
A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across disciplines, teams and regions while taking ownership of your work.
An interest in financial markets and how technology supports a global corporate and investment bank. Prior finance knowledge is not required.
A practical problem-solving mindset, clear communication skills and a willingness to learn through feedback, review and iteration.

What you will gain

Hands-on experience delivering technology in a global financial-services environment.
Structured learning, technical coaching, and support from colleagues and peers.
Exposure to software engineering, data and AI challenges with clear business relevance.
Opportunities to build a global network and understand how technology, product, and business teams deliver together.
A foundation for a long-term career in technology and financial markets.
 

How to Apply?  

All applicants are required to submit their CV and a Cover Letter. Only complete applications will be accepted.  


Please note that your application will not be considered complete without submitting your CV and Cover Letter. If during the application process your Cover Letter or CV was not uploaded, please send an email to uk.recruitment@tdsecurities.com titled “2027 Technology Grad – Your First & Last Name”.  


Please note that due to the high volume of applicants, we will only reach out to those that are being considered for the programme.  

 

TD Bank Group 

Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with more than 100,000 employees in offices around the world, The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries are collectively known as TD Bank Group (TD). TD offers a full range of financial products and services more than 25 million customers worldwide through three key business lines: 

Canadian Retail including TD Canada Trust, Business Banking, TD Auto Finance (Canada), TD Wealth (Canada), TD Direct Investing and TD Insurance 
U.S. Retail including TD Bank, America’s Most Convenient Bank, TD Auto Finance (U.S.), TD Wealth (U.S.) and TD’s investment in TD Ameritrade 
Wholesale Banking including TD Securities 

TD Securities is a leading global corporate and investment bank, delivering capital markets products, advisory services, trading expertise and market insights to corporate, government and institutional clients worldwide. Operating in 30 cities across the globe, we combine deep industry knowledge, innovation and global connectivity to help clients achieve their ambitions. 


Through our offices in London, Dublin and Belfast, we support clients across the UK, Ireland and Europe while leveraging the strength of our global platform and expertise. 


We are growth-oriented, people-focused, and community-minded. As a team, we work to deliver value for our clients every day. 

Who We Are  

TD Securities is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investment we make in our colleagues to help them, and their families achieve their well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, including medical coverage, paid time off, career development, and reward and recognition programs.

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
 
Colleague Development 

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities. 

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.  

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
 

Interview Process 
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

If you require an accommodation for the recruitment / interview process (including alternate formats of materials, or accessible meeting rooms or other accommodation), please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.
